name: magic-app-dev
description: Reusable Codex skills for independent app development and operations.

interface.shortDescription: 从需求调研到 Android 开发、商店发布与持续迭代。
interface.longDescription: Magic App Dev provides twelve reusable workflows for demand research, product planning, design approval, paired Android/legal workspace creation, implementation, architecture and whole-version review, device QA, mainline integration, first Google Play launch and updates, product analytics, stability diagnosis and iteration outcome verification. Project facts remain app-owned; store submission and publication remain owner-controlled by default.
defaultPrompt: 判断当前产品阶段并完成这次开发或迭代。
汇总本版本全部功能，审查架构偏移、文档一致性与回归证据。
准备 Google Play 发版并评估商店更新，停在我送审之前。
